title: Pale Vault Glacier - Glasslight
_note: Option C lush ambient register. era snes (8 voices, chords allowed, warm reverb) - the explicit richer-register option for this area; snes tempo floor is 60 so 66 BPM is fine. Suspended C major, Lydian-tinged F#: no firm thirds, sus2/sus4 and a glinting #4. Voices: soft bell-pad lead with long shimmering tones; a layered glassy bell chime arp; a sustained suspended pad (the chords chip eras couldn't stack, now ringing in full); a warm sustained low pad-bass, deep and still; a single soft reversed-cymbal aurora swoosh (ohat) per 4 bars; echo glues it. Vesper SUSPENDED/LUMINOUS: slow bell entries (G3->C4->D4 lift blooming into a sustained chord-swell), the settle dissolving into reverb rather than resolving. 16-bar loop; last bar holds a Dsus2 colour -> dissolves back into the bar-1 G lift. 5 voices peak, well within 8; clarity over count.
